If this attack ignites [gold]Oil[/gold], re-apply that [gold]Oil[/gold].

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 2 times.
If the enemy has [gold]Block[/gold], hits 2 more times.

Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].

[gold]Unlimited[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Upgrade this card X times.
THETINKERERMOD-APEX_MACHINERY_THE_TINKER:
At the start of your turn:
Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.

THETINKERERMOD-ENDLESS_SLUDGE_THE_TINKER:
[gold]Unlimited[/gold].
At the start of your turn, apply {Amount:diff()} [gold]Oil[/gold] to ALL enemies.
